tasks.subject: Task 1: Allow self-recursive tagged unions
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A tagged union's payload field types may reference the enum itself, directly and indirectly through typed collections, in both `enum` and `enum_name` forms.

**Verify:** `./bin/foundry.macos.editor.arm64 --headless test run --case "*FoundryScript*" --force-colors`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["modules/foundry_script/fs_analyzer.cpp", "modules/foundry_script/fs_analyzer_surface.cpp", "modules/foundry_script/GRAMMAR.md"], "verifyCommand": "./bin/foundry.macos.editor.arm64 --headless test run --case \"*FoundryScript*\" --force-colors", "acceptanceCriteria": ["direct payload recursion analyzes cleanly", "Array[T] recursion analyzes cleanly", "Dictionary[K,V] recursion analyzes cleanly", "inner enum form works", "recursive tree constructs and match-destructures at runtime", "int-backed self-referential value still rejected", "GRAMMAR.md updated"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Report enum cyclic-reference errors when linting a file alone
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A whole-file `enum_name` that will fail global resolution reports its error when linted on its own.

**Verify:** `script lint` on a bad enum_name file returns non-zero error count.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["modules/foundry_script/fs_analyzer.cpp"], "verifyCommand": "./bin/foundry.macos.editor.arm64 --headless test run --case \"*FoundryScript*\" --force-colors", "acceptanceCriteria": ["unresolvable payload type errors when linted alone", "valid enum_name file still reports zero errors", "no double-reporting"]}
```

tasks.description:

**Verify:** `./bin/foundry.macos.editor.arm64 --headless test run --case "*FSBuiltinSources*" --force-colors`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["modules/foundry_script/fs_builtin_sources.h", "modules/foundry_script/fs_builtin_sources.cpp", "modules/foundry_script/register_types.cpp", "modules/foundry_script/fs_analyzer.cpp", "modules/foundry_script/tests/test_fs_builtin_sources.h", "tests/test_main.cpp"], "verifyCommand": "./bin/foundry.macos.editor.arm64 --headless test run --case \"*FSBuiltinSources*\" --force-colors", "acceptanceCriteria": ["get_source returns registered text", "is_builtin_path only true for reserved prefix", "builtin path parses through dependency-parser path", "project file cannot shadow builtin path"]}
```
